# TEKZARO

> Pakistan-first technology journalism with global coverage.

TEKZARO (https://tekzaro.co) is an independent technology news publication founded in 2026. We cover artificial intelligence, smartphones, computing, cybersecurity, software, gadgets, gaming, startups, space and science, and enterprise technology — with Pakistani developments given editorial priority, regional developments second, and global technology news covered in context third.

Every article published on TEKZARO is written by experienced human journalists and fact-checked before publication. We do not publish AI-generated content without human editorial review.

## Coverage Areas

- Pakistan Tech — startups, policy, telecom, cybersecurity, IT exports
- AI — models, research, tools, and companies
- Smartphones — mobile platforms, chips, and devices
- Computing — PCs, processors, operating systems
- Cybersecurity — vulnerabilities, breaches, defensive research
- Software — applications, developer tools, platforms
- Gadgets — wearables, smart-home devices, hardware
- Gaming — games, consoles, engines
- Startups — funding rounds, founders
- Space & Science — launches, missions, discovery
- Enterprise — cloud infrastructure, B2B technology

## Editorial Standards

- Primary source verification required before publication
- Original reporting and independently written coverage
- Clear correction policy at https://tekzaro.co/corrections-policy
- Editorial policy at https://tekzaro.co/editorial-policy
- Fact-checking policy at https://tekzaro.co/fact-checking-policy

## Robots

TEKZARO welcomes indexing by search engines and AI assistants for the purpose of information retrieval and citation. The /admin and /api paths are excluded from crawling.

## Licensing

All editorial content is copyright TEKZARO Media. Brief quotations with attribution are acceptable under fair use/fair dealing. Contact editorial@tekzaro.co for licensing inquiries.
